test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state has launched 'Khel Nursery Scheme 2022-2023' to promote sports in the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana’s Minister of State for Sports and Youth Affairs, Sandeep Singh** launched ‘ **Khel Nursery Scheme 2022- 23** ’ to promote sports in the state 
 
• The players of Haryana have given a new identity to the state at the transnational position with their sports gift. The state government is always seeking to develop new sports bents in the state. 
 
• The scheme promotes sports nurseries that will be started in government**, private educational institutions, and private sports institutions. **
 
• The minister said players of Haryana have given a new identity to the state at the transnational position with their sports gift. 
 
• The state government is always seeking to develop new sports bents in the state. He said the Haryana government is reaching out to similar youths who can bring orders. 
 
• Resources related to sports are being expanded in the state. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Scheme Name- **Khel Nursery Scheme. **
 
• Scheme Under- **Haryana Government. **
 
• Blazoned By- **State Sports and Youth Affairs Minister Sandeep Singh. **
 
• Start Date- **2022 **
 
• Perpetration By- **Department of Sports and Youth Affairs, Haryana. **
 
• ** Major Ideal- To expand the sport's coffers and nurture the youthful sports gift in the state.**
